findings.text: §12's acceptance arm counts only `/_changes/sample` lines, and that marker reads zero on unfixed code: run under the arm's own setup (`HOME` at a scratch home carrying `.config/reckon/logs/`, RECKON_HOME unset), the whole of `tests/test_cross_node_writes_refresh_the_index.py` at base wrote one escaped access line into the scratch log — `[23:22:19] 127.0.0.1 GET /_index/sample HTTP/1.1 404 3.2ms` — with zero `/_changes/sample` lines anywhere in the scratch home, so "the head must read zero `/_changes/sample` lines" is satisfied by a run in which the leak is plainly present, and the head arm cannot show the fix works
